description: Synthesize definitions, caller/callee references, related tests, and architectural notes for a specific code symbol in a namespace (read-only, idempotent; consumes 1 Read API call) and return { results, total_candidates } (up to 20 ranked matches). Pass the identifier via symbol or its equivalent alias target (if both are supplied, symbol takes precedence). Use before editing a known function, class, or module to check its blast radius and invariants; use search_code instead when you only have keywords and need to find symbol names first.

namespace.description: Logical repository or workspace namespace containing indexed code memories.

symbol.description: Exact function, class, or module name to explain (preferred; equivalent to target).

target.description: Alias for symbol accepted for client compatibility when symbol is omitted.

name: explain_code

results.description: Ranked { memory, score } symbol definitions, callers, and architectural rules (max 20).

title: Explain Code Symbol
